source.title: Twilight Cultist Mantle — Retail item and comments

quote: These cannot be disenchanted nor can they be transmogrified.
notes: Archived first-person and set-level non-disenchant statements, including commenter 84551 recalling patch 2.3. Original Classic Silithus shoulder item; old comments and later appearance/item changes must not be read as an independently tested current Retail instance. Historical non-disenchant identity only.
